summary.en-US: Pause before scroll apps; read a classic on-device. Offline, once-paid

description.en-US:
Eruditio stands between you and your most-opened scroll apps. When a target app opens, a
brief friction screen appears: a short delay, a breathing moment, and an explicit choice —
continue into the app, or take a learning session instead.

Choosing the session opens a quiet, offline reading surface bundled with 30 public-domain
classics (Plato, Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, KJV selections, Spurgeon sermons, Augustine,
missionary biographies). Completed sessions feed an on-device spaced-repetition review
schedule with honest mastery levels (familiar / proficient / mastered), decay when
neglected, and a daily streak kept strictly separate from mastery metrics.

Privacy is the architecture, not a claim: no accounts, no sync, no ads, no trackers —
zero third-party SDKs. All progress lives on the device. The app costs once; future
content tracks arrive as optional packs. Never a subscription.

Eruditio uses the standard app-usage access API to detect when a chosen target app opens.
It never reads your browsing, never hard-blocks an app, and records only what you choose
at the pause screen.

description.en-US:
👪 Family Planz keeps your family on the same page — everything happening today, everything that needs doing, and everything to pick up on the way home. Mom and Dad plan the week; the kids always know what's due. SHARED FAMILY CALENDAR
  • Family events the whole household sees, with repeating schedules, times, and locations
  • RSVP so everyone knows who is coming
  • One calendar for the family: planning stays together, not split across apps
TASKS THAT ACTUALLY MOVE
  • Priorities and due dates, so the important work is sorted first
  • Hand a task to another family member — they accept or decline, and it lands on their list
  • Completion history, so "did that happen?" has an answer
DAY DASHBOARD
  • Today's events, the Top-3 Priorities for the family, and the Family Task Board on one screen — a good start to the day at breakfast.
GROCERIES
  • A check-off list sorted the way you shop — by store
  • The app remembers which store you buy each item at and orders the list accordingly
  • Checked-off items step aside until the next shopping run
QUICK ADD
  • Type a sentence and the app fills the form for you — you always confirm before it saves
AND ON THE WEB
  • Family Planz also runs in the browser — family data travels with the family account, on phones and computers alike.
